propositions: Drift in the Python public-API surface (removed symbols, renamed parameters, changed signatures) is not automatically detected, requiring manual upkeep of test_reuse_surface_doc.py and docs/reuse-surface.md in lockstep with every signature change.

A portable, stdlib-only (inspect/importlib) public-API surface drift gate is implemented as a --check/--update script and unit test, modeled on the existing config-key drift gate, and integrated into make test with no CI-provider dependency.

The hardcoded-subset signature assertions in test_reuse_surface_doc.py are subsumed by the new baseline-driven surface gate, removing the manual burden while preserving coverage over signing, prompt library, runner/contracts, and workflow executor.

The gate derives the guarded surface from a pinned source-of-truth rule: public members (via __all__ or owned non-underscore attributes) across a fixed MODULES list, capturing callables' parameter lists, class bases and dataclass fields, and values of immutable constants.
